description: This Java source file defines the class `ConnectionStatusMessageMapper`, which extends `AbstractMessageMapper`. It is responsible for mapping external messages into `ModifyFeature` commands that update the connection status feature of a device (thing) based on message headers. The class extracts headers like creation time and disconnect time (`ttd`) to create appropriate `ModifyFeature` or `ModifyFeatureProperty` instances. It also handles configuration validation and placeholder resolution for dynamic thing and feature IDs.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusMessageMapper
classes.description: A mapper class that converts incoming external messages into feature modification commands to update the connection status of a device (thing). It extracts relevant headers and creates appropriate 'ModifyFeature' or 'ModifyFeatureProperty' objects, supporting placeholders for dynamic values.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with the provided mapping configuration, resolving thingId and featureId options, and validating the thingId if not a placeholder.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an external message into a list of Adaptable objects, which are command representations for modifying device features. Handles exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: doMap
methods.description: Performs the internal logic to parse headers, resolve placeholders, validate values, and create modification commands based on message headers.

methods.name: getModifyFeaturePropertyAdaptable
methods.description: Creates an Adaptable object for modifying a feature property (readyUntil) based on the input parameters.

methods.name: getModifyFeatureAdaptable
methods.description: Creates an Adaptable object for modifying a feature (connection status), setting properties like readySince and readyUntil.

methods.name: applyPlaceholderReplacement
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a template string using the provided expression resolver.

methods.name: getExpressionResolver
methods.description: Constructs an ExpressionResolver for placeholders based on message headers.

methods.description: Builds a MessageMappingFailedException with a given message, description, and headers context.
